findings.motion: Senate 3rd Reading, SB 1174 Min et al.
findings.note: SB 1174 (Min, 2024) would prohibit a local government from requiring a person to present identification to vote or submit a ballot at a polling place, vote center or other ballot location, as specified; chaptered 2024-09-29. Digital Democracy lists Henry Stern among the 30 'For' votes on the Senate floor (30 for, 8 against).
subjects: local ban on voter ID requirements

findings.passage: It's our job to protect Californians' constitutional right to vote, free and unfettered. What other states do--with discriminatory voter ID laws and other voter suppression tactics--is unfortunately out of our hands.
findings.note: Joint statement of Senate and Assembly elections chairs (Stern and Marc Berman) on a federal executive order creating a voter-fraud commission; issued on Stern's Senate site; the text calls other states' voter ID laws discriminatory.

subjects: proof of citizenship to register (SAVE Act)
voter ID ban/permission for local governments
